why: This is a study-specific descriptive model of Iranian EFL writing teachers' feedback practices and contextual constraints, not a general theory of how people learn or are taught.
This is a study-developed cognitive flexibility assessment index rather than a reusable instructional element or teaching method.
name: New continuous cognitive flexibility index combining WCST switches and correct responses
product_description: A computer-administered Wisconsin Card Sorting Task scoring index developed by Ma et al. to quantify individual differences in cognitive flexibility among Chinese school-aged children by combining switching and correct-response performance.
